user.title: Welcome to Mammotion Mower Coordinator
user.description: Choose an already configured Mammotion mower. This companion organizes mowing areas, preserves progress, and explains why work is waiting. Setup only reads your configuration; it does not move the mower. Your mower must already be mapped in its app. This alpha starts in observation mode.

bindings.title: Check the mower sensors
bindings.description: Suggested sensors are selected only when their device association is unambiguous. Check each choice. Battery and progress must report percentages. Raw activity must match the supported adapter. Choose the current Self check sensor for mower health: its clear state is normal. Do not select historical error slots such as Error 1 code; those can retain old faults after recovery. Position and blade time are used as activity evidence. Rain, operator presence, and a safety permission sensor are required before control can be enabled; they can be omitted while observing. For manual safety permission, create a Toggle helper in Settings > Devices & services > Helpers, name it Lawn safety permission, and leave it off. Select that helper here, or use an existing safety binary sensor. Turn manual permission on only after inspecting property conditions. This is supervised permission, not obstruction detection; off or unavailable blocks movement. Optional weather adds protection; missing configured weather holds mowing. No sensor is bypassed with a fabricated safe value. Optional travel distance and RTK status strengthen physical recovery checks. Historical fault evidence is usable only as a code and timestamp pair scoped to the current incident; it cannot replace current Self check health. Automatic recovery requires fresh GPS position, travel distance (Maintenance distance) and RTK positioning mode Fix. These are suggested from the selected mower when unambiguous. If unavailable, choose observation mode or disable automatic recovery in rules until the bindings are supplied.

data.safety_entity: Property safety permission (Toggle helper or binary sensor)

zone.title: Configure a mowing area
zone.description: Give this logical area a name and select its native mower area switches. Each switch must have a positive map hash and belong to this mower. Do not assign a native area twice. Enter one direction angle, such as 0, or a comma-separated sequence such as 0,90. The direction advances after verified completion; a resumed job keeps its original direction. Settings must be supported by your mower; runtime preflight blocks unsupported profiles. Optional cutting height and speed are explicit overrides, not guessed app settings. Advanced: group areas under a shared name for calendar filtering. Monthly interval overrides use month numbers and days, for example {"1": 14, "7": 3}. Unlisted months use the normal interval. The stationary return limit bounds waiting away from the charger. Native path and order values must match your mower model. A group anchor becoming due makes its grouped followers eligible for the same plan; use a shared group name. Leave this off for independent area intervals.

data.name: Area name
data.angles: Direction angles in degrees, separated by commas
data.not_before: Do not mow before this date
data.group_anchor: Use this area as the group schedule anchor

more_areas.title: Add another area?
more_areas.description: You have configured {count} area(s). Add another area or continue to operating rules. There is no fixed five-area layout.

rules.title: Choose operating rules
rules.description: Times use Home Assistant’s timezone. This alpha supports a daytime window that ends after it starts. The reserve is the battery level for returning; it is not a promise that docking will succeed. A higher reserve may be needed for your property. Weather thresholds apply only when an external weather source is selected. Wind is normalized to meters per second. Freshness is the maximum accepted weather age. Automatic obstruction recovery and charger-free handoff remain disabled in this alpha. Automatic recovery and charger-free handoff are selected by default, but setup remains in observation mode until commissioning and arming. Recovery requires sustained lack of physical progress, a final telemetry grace period, and all safety gates; it never bypasses a fault based on an error number. Retries are bounded per incident, spaced by the cooldown, and stop for inspection when exhausted. Start confirmation time allows telemetry to catch up without duplicate starts. Handoff starts an eligible next area in place only after verified completion and sufficient battery; otherwise the mower returns to charge. Handoff battery must exceed the reserve. Saving options disarms control. Charger contact recovery requires stable charging and a battery increase; an accepted dock command alone is not success. Optional external-work protection allows an armed coordinator to request Dock for mowing started from another app or schedule when battery, rain, presence or time limits require a return. It never adopts or resumes that job. After a protective return, new plans stay blocked until the mower is docked, control is disarmed and you inspect it and reset the incident. Leave this off unless you want this explicit coordination with external starts.

data.allow_handoff: Continue eligible next area without charging first
data.contact_battery_gain: Battery increase required to confirm restored contact (%)
data.protect_unowned_work: Allow protective return for externally started work

notifications.title: Choose notifications
notifications.description: Choose existing notification destinations and the updates you want. Leave destinations empty to use Home Assistant status only. Quiet hours suppress routine messages; equal start and end times disable quiet hours. Urgent exceptions apply only if you explicitly enable them. No message is sent during setup. After setup, use Test notification and confirm it arrived—an accepted action alone does not prove delivery.

data.legacy_actions: Other notification actions (for example, a mobile app)
data.urgent_override: Allow needs-attention messages during quiet hours

review.title: Review and start observing

data.understood: I understand that setup starts observation only and physical operation is not yet verified

advanced.title: Optional advanced settings
advanced.description: The defaults work for an everyday interval schedule. Choose advanced setup for calendar exclusions, seasonal rules, weather forecasts and adaptive charging. You can change these later in integration options.

data.configure_advanced: Customize calendar, weather and charging now

calendar.title: Calendar and seasonal eligibility
calendar.description: Select allowed weekdays and months (1 is January). Excluded dates use YYYY-MM-DD separated by commas, for example 2027-01-01,2027-01-02. These holds also apply to recovery and recharge continuation. Empty eligible groups means all groups. Area-specific start dates and seasonal intervals are configured on each area. Rest days space completed plans apart without discarding unfinished work.

safety_weather.title: Weather protection
safety_weather.description: Configured sources must be available and fresh. The most restrictive weather source wins. The local rain sensor must still be dry. Light-rain tolerance is optional and applies only after this owned job has proven dry cutting; it never authorizes a wet launch. Forecast checking is optional and holds mowing when the required forecast is unavailable. The dry delay prevents immediate restart after rain.

data.light_rain_tolerance: Allow guarded continuation in light forecast rain

charging.title: Recharge planning
charging.description: Adaptive charging uses observed battery use for the remaining job and adds a buffer, bounded by your minimum and maximum targets. Without sufficient evidence the standard resume battery threshold applies. Stable charging must be verified before continuation; no movement is performed during setup.

data.adaptive_recharge: Adapt recharge target to remaining work

init.title: Mower configuration
init.description: Edit your settings, then choose Review and save to apply them. Leaving without saving discards these edits. Applying changes disarms control and retains saved job evidence.

zones.title: Choose an area to edit
zones.description: Renaming an area preserves its internal identity. Changing native areas or a cutting profile can make an existing checkpoint incompatible; the coordinator will hold it for review.

delete_zone.title: Remove this area?
delete_zone.description: This removes the area from future scheduling, not from your mower map. Saved work is retained as evidence and cannot be silently reassigned. At least one configured area is required.

data.confirm_delete: Remove this area from the coordinator
